items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: I recorded with the Fred Hirsch Trio doing Lerner and Loewe stuff.

ctx.x: Wow that’s a strong statement. So what do you want to be the best at?

I’m still figuring that out man. I’m still figuring it out. I guess it’s in a way it’s a weakness in terms of I guess career or marketing is that there’s so many things I love to do. You know right now, well right now, I mean no one’s working right now, but I have a kind of New Orleans traditional swing band, Professor Cunningham and his Old School, and that’s a lot of fun to do. But then I have more modern projects recently. I recorded with the Fred Hirsch Trio doing Lerner and Loewe stuff. And that was a…

different bag you know. So I love it all. And I’m just trying to figure out how to, you know — an uncle of mine always said, he had a lot of freckles, and he said, “One day my freckles are going to join up and I’m going to have an amazing tan.” I think about that with my music. One day I’m going to figure out how to put it all together into one thing you know.
